title: Page 4
slug: 仇人逼我嫁-芳妮-孟佳梨没想到当年老被她保护的小胖子竟变成眼前的帅哥总裁-他曾发誓以后换他保护她可现在欺负她最狠的就是他
content_zh:
“没有交集？”一抹嘲讽的笑容飘上了男人薄薄的唇角，下一瞬间，他身形一闪，狠狠扣住了孟佳梨的手腕，将她自椅子上扯了起来。

“好痛！”孟佳梨感到手腕传来一阵火辣辣的疼痛，彷佛可以听到自己骨骼被挤压的声响，让她痛呼出声。

“你也知道什么叫做痛吗？”男人笑着，眸底却是一片冰凉。

“你、你干么？快放开我！”她紧拧着眉头，汗水自额边沁出。

“你的手真是细啊，不知道我再用力些，可不可以就这样扭断它？”他将唇瓣移至她的耳畔，灼热的气息抚过她敏感的耳廓，在她细致的肌肤上激起一阵鸡皮疙瘩，让她心慌。

“你别忘了我刚刚才医治过你，难道堂堂总裁想恩将仇报，当个忘恩负义之徒？”她的声音微微轻颤，血色自唇瓣褪去。

“恩将仇报？忘恩负义？”男人的手骤地用力收紧，声音有如自地狱传来般阴冷。

“难道不是？”剧烈的痛楚自手腕传入脑门，让她冷汗直冒，但仍然强自镇定的回答。

“闭嘴！谁都有资格说这种话，就你没资格。”男人松开她的手腕低吼。

孟佳梨才感觉手腕的压力移开，下一瞬间那股巨大的力量却又爬上了她纤细的颈项，紧紧箍住，让她的呼吸一滞，几乎无法喘息。

他想杀了她。只见那双始终冰冷的瞳眸此刻微微眯着，眸底翻滚的是强烈的恨意，如刀刃般咻咻咻的刺向她，钳制在她脖子的大掌如钢铁般牢牢的扣住，原本尚存在胸腔的空气逐渐稀薄，让她整个呼吸道都像火烧似的灼痛着。

“放、放开……”她举起手，挣扎着想要扳开他的手，却根本如蚍蜉撼树，丝毫无法让那双粗厚的手掌移动分毫。

“怕了吗？你现在知道什么是绝望的滋味了？”他收起了声音中的冰寒，俯下头，唇瓣扫过了她的唇片，彷佛说着情话似的轻喃着，异常温柔。

孟佳梨睁大了眼瞪视着他，恐慌在心中蔓延开来。她可以感觉到体温逐渐自身体流失，脑袋因为缺氧而混沌，胸腔却灼烫不已，宛若炸开似的。

该死，被掐死的模样一点都不好看，难道自己今天真的遇到了劫数？

就在她体内最后一丝氧气消耗殆尽，整个人难得绷紧僵直之际，脖子上的钳制突然松开，她急急深吸口气，大量的空气瞬间涌入胸腔，让她无法自制的弯腰咳嗽着。

男人站直身子，冷眼看着她的狼狈，就像在欣赏自己的猎物做着垂死挣扎，眸底闪过异样的光芒，随即又隐没在淡漠之后。

“这只是开始。”他淡淡的开口。

“什、你……咳咳咳——”孟佳梨错愕的抬起脸，泪水因为剧烈的咳嗽而溢出眼角，“疯子，你疯了！”

“没错，早在当年耿家被孟家背叛，我父亲抑郁凄苦的病逝在医院时，我就疯了。”男人的怒火冲破了冷酷的面具，神情狰狞扭曲。

“耿、耿家？！”熟悉的容貌闪入脑海，那张始终挂着笑容的圆胖脸蛋，突然跟眼前这张俊美的脸庞交迭在一起。

男人看着她恍然大悟的神情，唇角嘲讽的扬起，十分满意她的惊愕，一字一字清楚的咬牙道：“我是耿、柏、恩。”

第2章(1)

孟佳梨最喜欢秋天，尤其最喜欢在秋天时分握着母亲的手漫步在山林间，母亲会温柔的拂去落在她发间的枯叶，疼惜的将薄外套披上她小小的身子，慈爱的望着她微笑，踏着夕阳余晖，好像她们可以这样永远走下去一般。

孟佳梨也最讨厌秋天，因为在这个季节，她被迫面对失去母亲的悲恸，在那冰冷的医院中，秋天不再是属于她跟母亲两人温馨漫步的回忆，而是比冬天更冷的阴冷。

她的世界，在八岁母亲病逝的同时，彻底崩坏。

看着父亲抱着母亲的遗体悲鸣，亲朋好友同情怜悯的目光，她坚强的没有掉出一滴泪水，只因为母亲去世前曾将父亲托付给她，要她代替自己好好照顾父亲，不要哭，只要记得她们曾在一起开心的时光，笑着迎接未来的生活。

所以即使小小年纪的她因为丧母而哀恸万分，那张如陶瓷般精致美丽的脸庞却依然面无表情，让许多上门吊唁的亲友们纷纷皱眉摇头，说她太冷情，甚至当父亲含泪拥着她，告诉她难受的话就大声哭出来没关系，她还是死命的拗着。

只有像现在，当她一个人躲在半山腰的防空洞时，才能卸下坚强的假面具，尽情发泄自己的悲伤，用泪水悼念母亲。

“我好想你，妈咪，你知道我好想你吗？啊——”孟佳梨朝着漆黑的洞内大喊，好像母亲就站在洞的尽头，依然微笑的望着她。

“呜呜呜，我真的好想你，你回来好吗？佳梨保证以后一定会很乖很乖，永远都不再惹你生气了，妈咪……”她哽咽的低语，身子无力的瘫坐在地上，泪水模糊了她的视线，在她脸上放肆的狂流，串成一条小河自下巴滑落，好像永远没有干涸的时候。

“梨……”忽地，一道迟疑的叫唤自洞外传来，打断了孟佳梨已转为呜咽的低泣。

坐在地上的纤细身影顿了顿，随即将脸埋入双膝间，闷声道：“干么？走开。”

“我……我陪你。”还带着稚气的男童声音低怯却坚定。

“我说不用你是没听见吗？”孟佳梨霍地抬起头，恶狠狠的瞪着他，把失去母亲的难过发泄在他身上。

小男孩没有因为她的怒气而退缩，反而朝她更走近些，一屁股在她身边坐下，黝黑的眸底是一片温暖，轻声道：“我不会说话，就陪着你。”

他毫不介意的态度让孟佳梨对自己方才的谩骂感到惭愧，一时之间却又拉不下脸来道歉，索性又把脸埋入膝间，默默的垂泪。

小男孩果然没打扰她，只是脱下外套披在她穿着单薄的身上，替她遮去自洞口不断吹入的刺骨寒风。

外套上还残留着他的体温，就像他的声音与动作一样温暖，在她冰冷的心中注入了一道暖流，又逼出她不少泪水。

不知道哭了多久，她终于平复情绪，正要抬头为自己方才的失控道歉时，洞外头却传来了一阵调侃的嘻笑声。

“羞羞羞，男生爱女生，羞羞羞！”

“不许你们乱讲话，走开！”小男生倏地站起身，胖胖的身躯挡在孟佳梨身前，努力让自己的声音充满威严。

“哇塞，死肥猪叫我们滚耶。”其中一个男生故作惊讶的大声嚷嚷。

“也不瞧瞧自己的长相，还想要英雄救美喔。”另一个男生跟着调侃。

“我们看看到底是谁要滚！”第三个男生恶狠狠的踏步上前，另外两个人也跟着走了进洞中。

“我只是叫你们走开，不是叫你们滚。”小男孩鼓起勇气挺直了背脊，不如以往的胆怯。

“我看你是太久没挨打了，所以才敢顶嘴。”带头的男生高出小男孩一个头，身强体壮，貌似哆拉A梦中的胖虎。

“别跟他啰唆，揍他一顿看他乖不乖。”

“打他，打他。”

两个跟班在一旁起哄。

他们三个一直都是学校的小恶霸，尤其爱欺负这个身材圆滚滚的小男孩，老是嘲笑他没妈妈，又笑他是胖子行动迟缓，三不五时就找他麻烦。

“你们找死吗？”一直被小男孩挡在身后的孟佳梨忽地站起身，推开了小男孩，红肿的双眼盛满了愤怒。
content_en:
"No intersection?" A mocking smile appeared on the man's thin lips. In the next moment, he flashed, grabbed Meng Jiali's wrist, and pulled her up from the chair.

"It hurts!" Meng Jiali felt a burning pain in her wrist, as if she could hear the sound of her bones being squeezed, making her cry out in pain.

"Do you also know what pain is?" The man smiled, but his eyes were cold.

"W-what are you doing? Let me go!" She frowned, sweat pouring from her forehead.

"Your hands are really thin. I wonder if I can break them just like this if I use more force?" He moved his lips to her ears, and his hot breath caressed her sensitive auricles, arousing goosebumps on her delicate skin, making her panic.

"Don't forget that I healed you just now. Could it be that the dignified CEO wants to repay a favor and become an ungrateful person?" Her voice trembled slightly, and the blood faded from her lips.

"Repaying kindness with revenge? Ungrateful?" The man's hands tightened suddenly, and his voice was as cold as coming from hell.

"Isn't it?" Severe pain spread from her wrist to her forehead, causing her to break into a cold sweat, but she still forced herself to answer calmly.

"Shut up! Anyone is qualified to say such things, but you are not qualified." The man let go of her wrist and growled.

Only then did Meng Jiali feel the pressure on her wrist move away. The next moment, the huge force climbed up to her slender neck and tightened it, making her breath stagnant and almost unable to breathe.

He wanted to kill her.The eyes that were always cold were narrowed slightly at this moment, with strong hatred rolling under them, stabbing at her like a blade, and the big palm clamping on her neck was as firm as steel. The air that was still in the chest gradually became thinner, making her entire respiratory tract burn like a fire.

"Let, let go..." She raised her hand and struggled to pry his hand away, but she was like a worm shaking a tree, unable to move the thick palms at all.

"Are you afraid? Now you know what despair feels like?" He put away the coldness in his voice, lowered his head, and brushed his lips over hers, murmuring softly as if speaking love words, extremely gentle.

Meng Jiali stared at him with wide eyes, panic spreading in her heart.She could feel her body temperature gradually draining from her body, her head was confused due to lack of oxygen, and her chest was burning as if it was exploding.

Damn it, the look of being strangled to death doesn't look good at all. Could it be that he really encountered a disaster today?

Just when the last trace of oxygen in her body was exhausted and her whole body became tense and stiff, the clamp around her neck suddenly loosened. She took a deep breath and a large amount of air instantly poured into her chest, causing her to bend over and cough uncontrollably.

The man stood up straight and looked at her embarrassment with cold eyes, as if he was admiring the death struggle of his prey. A strange light flashed in his eyes, and then disappeared behind indifference.

"This is just the beginning." He said calmly.

"Wha, you... cough cough cough -" Meng Jiali raised her face in shock, tears overflowing from the corners of her eyes due to violent coughing, "Madman, you are crazy!"

"Yes, I went crazy as early as when the Geng family was betrayed by the Meng family and my father died of depression and misery in the hospital." The man's anger broke through the cold mask, and his expression was ferocious and twisted.

"Geng, Geng family?!" A familiar face flashed into his mind, and the chubby face that always had a smile suddenly overlapped with the handsome face in front of him.

The man looked at her expression of sudden realization and raised the corners of his lips mockingly. He was very satisfied with her astonishment. He gritted his teeth and said clearly every word: "I am Geng, Bo, En."

Chapter 2(1)

Meng Jiali loved autumn the most, especially holding her mother's hand and walking in the mountains and forests in autumn. Her mother would gently brush away the dead leaves that fell in her hair, lovingly put a thin coat on her little body, look at her lovingly and smile, and step into the sunset, as if they could go on like this forever.

Meng Jiali also hated autumn the most, because in this season, she was forced to face the grief of losing her mother. In that cold hospital, autumn was no longer a warm memory of her and her mother walking together, but a colder feeling than winter.

Her world completely collapsed when her mother died of illness at the age of eight.

Seeing her father wailing while holding her mother's body, and the sympathetic and pitiful eyes of her relatives and friends, she was strong enough not to shed a single tear, just because her mother had entrusted her father to her before her death, asking her to take good care of her father on her behalf. Don't cry, just remember the happy times they had together, and smile to welcome the future life.

So even though she was in great mourning because of the loss of her mother at a young age, her face as delicate and beautiful as porcelain remained expressionless. Many relatives and friends who came to express condolences frowned and shook their heads, saying that she was too cold. Even when her father hugged her with tears and told her that it was okay to cry loudly if she felt uncomfortable, she still held on for dear life.

Only like now, when she was hiding alone in an air-raid shelter halfway up the mountain, could she take off her strong mask, vent her sorrow to her heart's content, and mourn her mother with tears.

"I miss you so much, Mommy, do you know I miss you so much? Ah -" Meng Jiali shouted into the dark cave, as if her mother was standing at the end of the cave, still looking at her with a smile.

"Uuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuu I really miss you, please come back, please? Jia Li promises that she will be very good and will never make you angry again, Mommy..." She choked in a whisper, and slumped on the ground weakly. Tears blurred her vision, flowing wildly on her face, forming a small river and sliding down her chin, as if it would never dry up.

"Pear..." Suddenly, a hesitant call came from outside the cave, interrupting Meng Jiali's sobs that had turned into sobs.

The slender figure sitting on the ground paused, then buried his face between his knees and said in a muffled voice: "What are you doing? Go away."

"I...I'll accompany you." The childish boy's voice was low but firm.

"Didn't you hear me when I said no?" Meng Jiali raised her head and glared at him fiercely, venting her sadness of losing her mother on him.

The little boy did not flinch because of her anger. Instead, he walked closer to her and sat down next to her. His dark eyes were warm and he said softly: "I can't speak, so I will stay with you."

His nonchalant attitude made Meng Jiali feel ashamed of the insult she had just given, but for a moment she couldn't bring herself to apologize, so she simply buried her face in her knees and wept silently.

As expected, the little boy didn't bother her. He just took off his coat and put it on her thin body to shield her from the biting cold wind that kept blowing in from the entrance of the cave.

His body temperature still remained on the coat, as warm as his voice and movements, injecting a stream of warmth into her cold heart and forcing many tears out of her.

She didn't know how long she cried, but she finally calmed down. Just when she was about to raise her head to apologize for losing control, a burst of teasing laughter came from outside the cave.

"Shame, shame, shame, boys love girls, shame, shame, shame!"

"You are not allowed to talk nonsense, go away!" The little boy stood up quickly, blocking Meng Jiali's body with his fat body, trying to make his voice full of dignity.

"Wow, you fat pigs are telling us to get out of here." One of the boys shouted loudly, pretending to be surprised.

"You don't even want to look at your own looks. You want a hero to save your beauty." Another boy joked.

"Let's see who wants to get out!" The third boy stepped forward fiercely, and the other two followed him into the cave.

"I'm just telling you to go away, not get out." The little boy mustered up the courage to straighten his back, not as timid as before.

"I think you haven't been beaten for a long time, so you dare to talk back." The leading boy is a head taller than the little boy. He is strong and looks like the fat tiger in Doraemon.

"Don't nag him. Give him a good beating to see if he behaves."

"Hit him, hit him."

Two followers were making noises from the side.

The three of them have always been the little bullies in school, and they especially loved to bully this chubby little boy. They always teased him for not having a mother, and also laughed at him for being fat and slow, and always causing trouble for him.

"Are you looking for death?" Meng Jiali, who had been blocked by the little boy, suddenly stood up and pushed the little boy away, her red and swollen eyes filled with anger.
